notes.title: Spells & Secrets Patch 1.04 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
Today we have a small patch to fix an issue with Chinese localization not being properly enabled. Also includes fixes for a few other rarely occurring issues.

Bug Fixes

Co-Op: Fixed an issue where a defeated player could cast spells under specific conditions.
Co-Op: Fixed an issue caused by entering the dungeon while one player was defeated.
Fixed an issue where selecting Simplified Chinese as language would not properly update texts in-game.
Fixed an issue where interaction VFX could stack on the players wand while defeated.
Fixed an issue where a defeated player could revive themself after defeating the final boss.
Demo: Fixed an issue that could result in getting stuck at the beginning of the tutorial when loading after saving and loading in a specific way during the intro section of the game.

notes.title: Spells & Secrets Patch 1.03 - Co-Op Update - Patch Notes
notes.content:
Dear Students of Greifenstein!

With this update, we are finishing our work on new co-op and quality of life features. As opposed to the recent Update 1.02b, this is not a beta update and its content is available in the default version as well as the demo version of the game. All changes from the previous beta update will also be available in this new version, and the public beta branch has been disabled as a result.

Check out the new changes below! 

New Features

Added language support for Simplified Chinese.
Demo: Updated the demo to match the main game. This includes all Co-Op features and other changes.
Demo: Added language support for multiple languages to match the main game: French, Spanish, Italian, Japanese and Simplified Chinese.


Changes

Co-Op: All relevant in-game UI screens (like shops or smartphone apps) can now only be navigated by the player who opened that screen.
Added different cursor visuals to help identify which player is currently in control of a UI screen.
Adjusted Bombard spell balance by increasing charge time, recovery time and mana cost and reducing its maximum range.
The “Essence Channeler” artefact now reduces Bombard’s charge time instead of making the first charge stage instantaneous. Adjusted the artefacts description accordingly.
Adjusted the mana cost of the “Potato Cannon” artefact to match Bombard’s base mana cost.
Note: Bombard was too comfortable and efficient when compared to other offensive options. The above changes were made to make other offensive spells and combos more viable when compared to the basic Bombard spell.
Disabled friendly fire for Barrage. This spell no longer affects allied entities.
Updated descriptions of Slash and Barrage to properly communicate these spells not causing friendly fire.
Removed the “save” option in the in-game character customization, as it was redundant with the “Save and Play” option.
Adjusted some UI elements to be compatible with the Steam Deck.
New texts with missing translations in languages other than English and German have been updated with final translation.
Adjusted japanese glyphs to prepare for chinese localization.
Demo: Disabled issue report hint displayed during loading screen.


Bug Fixes

Co-Op: Fixed the co-op partner’s companion applying contact effects to the other player.
Co-Op: Fixed offscreen indicator arrows not being colored in different player colors.
Co-Op: Fixed extra spell slots in the spell organizer not having the correct player color.
Fixed an issue with secret reward pools that caused secret puzzles to not reward a variety of containers with the intended distribution in the second and third floors.
Fixed the mimic ability of Magical Poltergeists being able to copy reward containers.
Fixed Slash not being able to destroy ice pillars.
Fixed a typo in german device assignment loca

notes.title: Spells & Secrets Public Beta Patch 1.02b - Patch Notes
notes.content:
With this update, we are working on improving the local co-op experience while fixing various bugs and issues. This is a public beta update with work-in-progress changes that are not yet available in the main version of the game.

You can get access the public beta branch containing all of these mentioned changes as follows:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41623578/ac10702234bdfdc245a1e165a5d464c1f615dae0.pngOpen the game’s properties in your Steam library by pressing the “Manage” button or right clicking the game in your list of games. Navigate to the “Betas” panel, open the “Beta Participation” dropdown, then choose the “public_beta” option. The game should now automatically update and download the public beta version.

Should you encounter any issues with these new features, we would be very grateful for your issue report. Press F1 at any time while in-game to open the issue report overlay. Don’t forget to attach the automatically created data package to your bug report, as it is essential for us to reproduce the issue you may have encountered!


New Features

Implemented an In-Game Device Assignment UI

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41623578/aedda2a2ed3573090767542034aa2101669af099.png

This system allows you to view any connected input devices and assign them to different players in local co-op.
Enabling local co-op no longer requires any specific input devices to be connected. You will still require at least two different connected input devices to properly control both players.
The Device Assignment UI will pause the game and open automatically when local co-op is enabled or whenever an input device is connected or disconnected.
You can access the Device Assignment UI via the pause menu, or open it at any time by pressing F2.
If you are using Steam Remote Play Together, Player 2 can use their mouse & keyboard only if you enable it in the Remote Play Settings in the Steam Overlay.


Implemented Local Co-Op Saving & Loading

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41623578/10f927b7b41ccbdcdb7b501b0b96e643bb64a610.png

Leaving the game during a run or while in the Hub will now save whether or not local co-op is enabled, indicated by the co-op icon in your character library.
Loading a save with enabled local co-op will ask you to choose a co-op partner or disable local co-op before continuing.
The loadout of your co-op partner is now saved and loaded if a save is continued in local co-op.
Added information about the save that will be loaded when pressing play in the main menu.

Localisation for new features in languages other than English and German will be implemented with a future patch when these features are finalized.


Changes
Changed Levitate’s effect to have greatly reduced duration when affecting players and bosses.
Slightly reduced Levitate’s effect duration when charged.
Changed Ramlings to lose their shield instantly when interrupted or exploited instead of it only being removed after a brief moment.

This should make attacks timed perfectly with exploiting a Ramling more reliable.
Changed Ramlings to now also be bouncy while rolling.
Changed Vex, the Sly to no longer use her ultimate spell while she is affected by her boss shield effect.


Bug Fixes

Fixed an issue that caused the last artefact of each artefact category to not be properly generated into shops and artefact containers.
This issue should make the 8th barrage artefact finally obtainable, while also fixing other artefacts being more rare than intended.
Fixed an issue that could cause connected controllers to vibrate indefinitely.
Fixed an issue that caused the “Frozen Droplet” artefact for Levitate to not freeze bosses as intended.
Fixed trigger positions in some boss rooms allowing for enemies becoming stuck in between navgrid and killzone.
Fixed some artefacts not appearing properly in the Shinehunter’s showcases and shops despite being collected.
Fixed the killzone reset effect affecting props.
Fixed small typos in German texts.


Known Issues

In local co-op, opening the smartphone or a shop allows both players to navigate and interact with the UI.
We are looking to implement a solution that will allow only the player who opened it to navigate and interact with such UI screens.
In local co-op, your co-op partner’s companion can affect and deal damage to you with its contact effects instead of you being immune to those as intended.
Secret puzzle rewards in the second and third floor are not distributed correctly. Solving a puzzle in these floors will currently only ever reward a lucky bag instead of randomly picking from a pool of different containers as intended.

notes.title: Spells & Secrets Patch 1.01 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
Greetings fellow students of Greifenstein!

With this first patch we are addressing some issues with local Co-Op, story achievements, and more.

We are continuing to work on improving the game based on your reports and feedback. Should you encounter any issue while playing, you can press F1 to open and use our in-game issue report tool. Please make sure to attach the automatically created data package in any issue report, as it contains vital information about the version and game state!

Thank you all for your support and for enjoying Spells & Secrets!

Changes

Schoolmates in the Fireblade Hall are now disabled during any boss or player duel.

This change should greatly enhance performance during combat.

Slightly adjusted some texts and UI elements to improve player guidance.

Texts in languages other than English and German and will be updated with a future patch.



Bug Fixes

Local Co-Op: Fixed an issue that allowed one player to heal the other with the Partner spell while they were transformed into a creature.
Local Co-Op: Fixed an issue that could cause faction leader dialogues to trigger out of order when entering the faction area for the first time while playing with a friend.
Local Co-Op: Fixed an issue that caused consumables picked up and used by player 2 to not count towards progress with the Dreamdancer student faction.
Fixed an issue that allowed teleportation between rooms during the different phases of the final boss fight.
Fixed the mechanics of the “Super Compact Instant Tent” artefact for Timewarp not matching its description and intended design.

This artefact no longer grants agile in addition to it granting manaflow.

Fixed an issue that caused some story related steam achievements to not be properly unlocked.

Loading a character that has already unlocked the related in-game awards should retroactively unlock the affected Steam achievements.

Fixed an issue that caused the game to be stuck in an infinite loading screen when trying to load a severely outdated character save file.
Fixed an issue with most artefact descriptions in the collection not using localized texts, displaying them as English in any language.
Fixed an issue with descriptions of Rootling variants in the collection being mixed up.
Fixed a typo in the German title of the mana recovery upgrades.


Known Issues

Local Co-Op runs are saved and loaded in single-player instead of being able to be continued in local Co-Op.

We are working on a solution that will allow you to choose and continue a saved local Co-Op run with a partner when loading it.
A local Co-Op session saved in the Castle or Hub will also save your friend’s spell loadout and load it if you continue to play in local Co-Op.

Local Co-Op requires two controllers to be enabled and doesn’t support mouse & keyboard.

We are working on a solution that will allow you to enable local Co-Op regardless of connected input devices.
This solution will also allow you to assign any connected input devices to be used by any player while local Co-Op is enabled, including mouse & keyboard.




Community Quest: Heading Towards 100 Reviews 🚀
We're on an epic quest to hit 100 reviews on Steam, and guess what? We're already at 64! 🎉 Your insights 💭 and adventures in "Spells & Secrets" mean the world to us and other players. We'd absolutely love it if you could share your honest thoughts about the game. Remember, your reviews don't just give us a boost - they guide other aspiring wizards in navigating and relishing the magical world of "Spells & Secrets." 🌌 Let's make this quest a success together!

Thank you for being a part of our magical community. Let's continue to cast spells 🪄 and create wonders together! ✨

With magical regards,

notes.title: Calling All Wizard Apprentices and Adventurers 🌟
notes.content:
Exciting news for everyone who can't wait to walk the magical halls of Greifenstein Academy! Our highly anticipated game, "Spells & Secrets," is nearing its release, and we're thrilled to invite you to get an exclusive early look into our magical world 🪄.

How Can I Participate in the Playtest? 🎮
We're conducting a limited Playtest on Steam. To join in, all you have to do is visit our Steam Store page and click the button to apply for the Playtest. Spots are limited, so don't hesitate—apply as soon as possible!

What's Next? 📅
All selected participants will gain access to the beta between September 18th and 24th. After the beta phase, we'll analyze all the collected data and your feedback to make final improvements and adjustments. Don't miss this opportunity to have a real impact on the development of "Spells & Secrets"!

How Do I Report to You? 📝
Please use the in-game reporting feature. To do this, press F1 during gameplay. This will generate a report file on your PC desktop, and an online form will open in your browser. Use this feature especially for reporting errors/bugs. Additionally, we ask you to fill out the following survey, as it's an extra way for you to share your gameplay experience with us.

Join Our Discord Community 🗨️
Don't forget, we also have an active Discord server where we invite not only the testers but also all fans of "Spells & Secrets" to join! It's a great place to discuss your experiences, share your magical discoveries, and provide direct feedback to our team. Plus, it's a fantastic way to connect with fellow wizards and adventurers. Click here to join us now and be a part of our growing magical community! 🌌

We can't wait to welcome you all to Greifenstein Academy 🏰 and are excited to see the magical adventures you'll embark on.


No more stream restriction

notes.title: New Demo
notes.content:
Hey students of Greifenstein,

We're happy to bring you some exciting updates on the development of Spells & Secrets. 

🎮New Demo
Today, we are launching a new demo for Spells & Secrets with several key changes:

- Optimized Tutorial: We've made the tutorial more user-friendly, helping players get up to speed more quickly and feel more engaged. We noticed that many users did not always know where to go, so we have now included an indicator that guides the user.

- Performance Enhancements: We've worked tirelessly to optimize performance, addressing issues like crashes after extended gameplay sessions. If you encountered these problems before, please let us know your feedback via Discord or use the ingame bug/feedback report tool with F1 on your keyboard.

- Spell Cast-Time: We've revamped spell casting mechanics. For example, the standard Arcane Spell now fires instantly without the need for charging.

- Improved Mouse and Keyboard Controls: PC controls have been significantly improved for a smoother gaming experience. Thank you for your feedback.

No more stream restriction
With the release of the demo and the upcoming beta, we are lifting the streaming restriction. Watching you play has been incredibly helpful in improving the game. To all content creators out there, let's dive in and showcase Spells & Secrets!

notes.content:
Hey my magical friends,

it's time again to tell you what we are doing and what is happening on Greifenstein!
Please remember everything is still a work in progress and can change during development.

Last Call for all  “Create your own statue/NPC student character” Backer
This month we'll start implementing your created statues and NPC students! All who have not yet submitted have been individually written again! This is the last call, if you are not sure if you are one of the backers please contact us!

Let’s talk about artifacts
It's time to tell you a bit more about artifacts, how they work, what they are called, and what they actually do!

I will explain the main spells to you today, all of which can be expanded and improved by artifacts! But to explain that one by one would fill a whole book 😱

In Spells & Secrets, there are currently 21 spells that can be learned gradually through experience points from the school's teachers. The artifacts, on the other hand, can be found in a School run and only there.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41623578/c2f5b0df444071165c191cd0fabe1e045928cc11.jpg
Artifacts can be found in the School in such containers

And as you can see in the picture below, there are a lot of artifacts. Each spell has its own unique 8 artifacts. If you haven't learned a particular spell yet, you won't get artifacts for it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41623578/74b721f4f11b2828aaab3a8b7a4b2e2df3a43b7f.jpg

Enough talk, we would like to show you the influence of artifacts in the game using Magic Missile and Telekinesis.


[previewyoutube=FCXJGv-cx-o;full][/previewyoutube]

[previewyoutube=ZOuPRm2T0m8;full][/previewyoutube]

Environment polishing
You may not notice it directly, but the rooms all look much livelier because of all the little things that show that students live here! A backpack here, books there, floating candelabras above your heads, casting their shadows as you experience your adventures!

General Overview

 Music is implemented in the right places
 VFX/Audios of the enemies are worked out
 Special rooms for Q&A are built in if any abnormalities during testing need to be checked again.
 Quick cheat UI is implemented so the porting can be done and tested faster for the consoles 😉
 The story is in progress ( working on dialogues)
 all puzzles are technically implemented with different variants where possible
 working on balancing (Enemy distribution, health, damage, etc)

notes.title: Survey issues and news from Kickstarter
notes.content:
Hi, my magical family,
we are back from Gamescom and full of energy after meeting so many awesome backers and fans of Spells & Secrets!
It was incredible to finally be back live and in person at Gamescom after 2 years, over 30k Wishlist, new friends made, old ones reunited and an IGN feature behind us, you can imagine what the time was like.

Current Status
87% of you have already answered the survey that was sent out before the Gamescom, please check your spam folders and make sure which mail address you have entered! a reminder will be sent out automatically in the next 2 weeks!

For those who have not received the survey, please check your mail address and all folders, if you still have not received anything after the reminder we have to do detective work and try to find out what could be the reason! We know some of you have this issue and we will try to find a solution! When you already filled out the survey, don´t do it twice, please! EVERYONE will get automatically the reminder, this doesn´t mean your survey is missing!

For all Questions, please check out our previous update which has been posted before Gamescom! If you can´t find an answer there, just contact us! 

Character Editor
I guess you can't wait to finally create your own NPC for us, can you? The backers with this reward will soon get their money's worth! At the moment we are working on this part of “create your own NPC student character” so that you can create, extract and send us your NPC as promised. How this exactly will work and when you get to try it out, you will find out in the next update!


More games to love
[previewyoutube=pjjwdCwFooE;full][/previewyoutube]
Lou´s Lagoon
A cozy open-world adventure about running a seaplane delivery service. Customize your character, discover new islands, harvest goods, solve a family mystery, and work to keep an adorable island community afloat.

Since it’s not actually in the ‘Talespin’ universe, we had to make some changes, the main one being that our protagonist is a human rather than a giant bear (there are plenty of animal friends in the game though). As well as seaplane piloting, we also mixed in some ‘life sim’ elements from games like My Time at Portia.
